en.headline: Tuen Mun light public housing next to take in tenants, housing chief says
en.dek: Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho said projects at Yan Po Road and Tsing Fat Street will be the next batch to open after four estates already began intake this year.
body: Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho Wing-yin said on Sunday that two light public housing projects in Tuen Mun — at Yan Po Road and Tsing Fat Street — will be the next to take in residents. She described 2026 as a “harvest year” for the programme after intake had already begun at Kai Tak Olympic Avenue phases one and two, Choi Shek Lane in Kowloon Bay and Sheung On Street in Chai Wan.

Ho said on a social media post that Under Secretary Dai Shengcheng had visited the Tsing Fat Street office to inspect how the operator was handling allocations and to speak with prospective tenants completing eligibility checks. She quoted one applicant as saying they had inspected the site the day after receiving a notice and decided to take up a flat after finding the surroundings quiet.

Officials and the operator briefed visitors on on-site facilities, transport links and job-matching support, including posts inside the estate and placements across Hong Kong. Ho said the bureau would continue to roll out remaining projects so households waiting for conventional public rental housing could move in earlier. No intake date for the two Tuen Mun sites was given in the Sunday remarks.

zh.headline: 何永賢：屯門兩簡約公屋項目將成下一批入伙
zh.dek: 房屋局局長表示屯門欣寶路及青發街項目將相繼入伙，並稱今年是簡約公屋「豐收年」，已有四個項目開始交樓。
body: 房屋局局長何永賢週日表示，屯門欣寶路及青發街兩個簡約公屋項目，將會是下一批入伙項目。她形容今年是簡約公屋的「豐收年」，啟德世運道第一及第二期、九龍灣彩石里及柴灣常安街項目已陸續交樓。
何永賢在社交平台發文，指副局長戴尚誠早前到青發街簡約公屋辦事處，視察營運機構處理編配，並與前往辦理資格審查的準住戶交流。她引述一名街坊稱，收到通知翌日已到場查看，覺得環境清靜，因而決定入住。
局方及營運機構向準住戶介紹屋邸設施、交通配套，以及就業支援，包括在項目內聘用居民及提供港九新界工作配對。何永賢稱會繼續落實其餘項目，讓輪候傳統公屋的住戶可較早上樓。她週日未有公布兩個屯門項目的具體入伙日期。
